name: Power Protection TLR

origin.basis: French tire maker; Michelin's UK site lists its bicycle range and dealers.

manufacturing.basis: Michelin's size list does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Year-round tubeless road tire with bead-to-bead puncture and pinch protection.
hookless_note: Michelin lists every size (28-35 mm) for hooked and hookless rims.
weight_basis: Michelin's size list shows no weights; no maker weight was found.
pressure_note: Michelin's size list gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Michelin positions it for tough road conditions all year round, listing grip among its key benefits.

availability.note: Sold by Michelin's official Tmall store in mainland China; listed on Michelin's UK site with a dealer locator; North American availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.market: Michelin official Tmall store (米其林官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 543.08.

caveats: No independent lab test or maker weight found.
Protection-focused: expect more weight and rolling resistance than the Power Cup TLR.

image.shown: 700x28C Power Protection TLR as pictured on Michelin's product page.
image.alt: Michelin Power Protection TLR road tire standing upright at an angle

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist; bundle pages that add inner tubes are not read), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Colour options on the same product page count as the same tire.

reports.summary: Holds air well tubeless, rolls and grips well, and shows no wear or puncture after 400 km.
